name: Fallen Dreg
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A small ranged skirmisher. Strafe between shock-pistol bursts and avoid being surrounded.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Fallen Wretch
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A melee pursuer. Backpedal and fire before its spear reaches you.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Fallen Sniper Vandal
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A long-range rifle unit. Move between cover and avoid standing still in an open firing lane.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Fallen Captain (Shrapnel Launcher)
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A shielded Captain carrying a Shrapnel Launcher. Break its shield, watch the blink flash, then reacquire it.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Fallen Scorch Captain
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A shielded Captain carrying a Scorch Cannon. Keep solid cover for the rockets and watch its blink.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Fallen Shank
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A small hovering drone. Track its lateral movement and eliminate it before taking on heavier units.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Fallen Bruiser [Ketchkiller]
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Watch for the blink as it closes the gap. Step out of reach of its four claws. The heavy cross-strike can knock you back.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Devil Walker
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Sustained damage depletes 55 points of leg integrity.
A leg break staggers the Walker for 6.5 seconds.
During that stagger it takes 2.4x damage. Save heavy shots for that opening.
Repeat leg breaks and clear the Shanks/Captain reinforcements.
threats: Leave its cannon firing line while it charges.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Sepiks Prime
spawn: Craft the named challenge sigil at a crafting table; use it on clear ground.
mechanics: At 70% health, Sepiks shields itself and calls a Captain tether guard.
Defeat the tether guard to remove immunity; clear the accompanying Shank.
At 35% health, it calls two Captain guards. Clear both.
Focus the central eye between shield phases.
threats: It blinks while firing volleys.
Close-range attacks let Sepiks damage a target and heal itself.
reward: Two Conquest Tokens plus inherited boss drops.

name: Blast Servitor
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A floating Servitor variant. Focus its central eye and keep distance from explosive pressure.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Vanok, the Arclite
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Vanok enters shield phases as its health drops.
Defeat the tethered Servitor guards to end immunity.
Watch for its teleport and avoid close-range Arc bursts.
Resume focused damage once protection falls.
threats: Pressure increases in the final health phase.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Exploder Shank
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Destroy this drone before it reaches close range. Its final approach ends in an explosion.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Tracer Shank
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A precision Shank. Break sightlines and fire during the gaps between shots.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Heavy Shank
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A larger shielded drone. Sustained fire breaks protection; finish it while exposed.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Devils Ether Servitor
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A support Servitor. Prioritize it when it is sustaining other Fallen units.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Riksis, Devil Archon
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Riksis is a durable Fallen field boss with a shield and close-range stomp.
Break the shield with sustained fire, then keep range from the stomp.
Use cover between its Shrapnel Launcher attacks.
threats: Flanking helps prevent its frontal fire from pinning you down.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Hive Thrall
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: The Thrall lunges and claws with its left hand, then its right. Each claw deals 1.5 base damage.
The claws land four ticks apart. Stepping out of reach or behind cover can make the second swipe miss.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Cursed Thrall
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Glows before its close-range detonation. Shoot early or retreat from the 3.5-block blast.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Hive Acolyte
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Fires timed soulfire bursts. Use solid cover and move between bursts.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Hive Boomer Knight
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Below 72% health, it can raise a frontal shield and heal. Flank during the stance; frontal hits deal only 12% damage during its protected frames.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Hive Wizard
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Floats while firing and casts a marked poison cloud. Leaving the cloud lets its two-second poison and Darkness effects expire.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Hive Ogre
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A durable eye-blast unit. Keep cover between bursts and avoid its heavy close-range melee.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Hive Shrieker
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A stationary hovering turret. Use cover, then burst it down from a clear firing angle.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Lucent Lightbearer Knight
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Uses a healing shield stance like other Knights. After defeating it, destroy the Hive Ghost before it revives the Knight.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Lucent Hive Ghost
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A resurrection support unit released by a Lucent Knight. Destroy it promptly to prevent revival.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Lucent Overshield Moth
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A small hovering explosive threat. Shoot it before it reaches its close-range burst.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Oryx, the Taken King
spawn: Craft the named challenge sigil at a crafting table; use it on clear ground.
mechanics: Oryx flies and rotates through a marked slam, Gathering Darkness and a charging sword attack.
Leave the slam circle and move sideways off his charge path.
During Gathering Darkness, deal 28 raw damage to interrupt the cast and stagger him.
If you cannot interrupt it, retreat beyond 14 blocks or break line of sight before the blast.
threats: The Darkness blast arrives about 4.1 seconds into its cast.
This fight uses open-world attacks; it has no platform or bomb puzzle.
reward: Four Conquest Tokens plus inherited boss drops.

name: Vex Goblin
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A ranged Vex unit with an exposed radiolarian core. Strafe between bolts and aim at the bright body core.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Vex Hobgoblin
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A precision unit that enters a healing lock below 68% health. It takes only 18% damage during protected lock frames; use that pause to reposition.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Vex Harpy
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A hovering Vex drone. Track its movement and focus the central eye between its volleys.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Hezen Praetorian Minotaur
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A shielded heavy Vex unit with blink repositioning. Watch the departure flash and leave room behind you.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Vex Hydra
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Rotating shield sectors reduce damage to 25%. Change your firing angle to shoot through a gap.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Vex Wyvern
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Crouches over a landing marker, jumps, then dives into the marked location. Dodge sideways and attack during the landing recovery.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Vault Oracle
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A floating encounter node. Destroy it when a boss mechanic calls for removing an Oracle or shield node.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Persys, Primordial Ruin
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: Persys uses a heavier Wyvern leap-and-dive attack.
Watch the crouch and marked landing circle, then move sideways.
Attack during its recovery and keep room to escape the next dive.
threats: This retained field boss has no reactor-door puzzle.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Atheon, Time's Conflux
spawn: Craft the named challenge sigil at a crafting table; use it on clear ground.
mechanics: Atheon periodically grants nearby Guardians Time's Vengeance.
Watch for the announcement: the bonus lasts eight seconds.
Use that window for your strongest shots while moving around its projectile bursts.
threats: There is no teleport or oracle-order puzzle in this version.
reward: Four Conquest Tokens plus inherited boss drops.

name: Protheon, Modular Mind
spawn: Craft the named challenge sigil at a crafting table; use it on clear ground.
mechanics: Protheon uses the articulated Vex ranged and melee move set.
Strafe between bursts and move away when it closes for melee.
Aim at the exposed radiolarian core and use solid cover to reload.
threats: The fight stays in your world; no arena-floor transitions occur.
reward: Two Conquest Tokens plus inherited boss drops.

name: Vex Sphinx
spawn: Existing faction encounters and spawn eggs.
mechanics: A heavy Rising Vex adaptation with two articulated tentacles over its shoulders. Dodge the marked two-part tentacle strike and watch for blink repositioning.
threats: Avoid being surrounded by supporting units.
reward: Faction materials and inherited enemy drops.

name: Legionary
spawn: Deserts, badlands and savannas.
mechanics: Fires a three-shot burst after raising its weapon.
Move between bursts; solid blocks stop the incoming bolts.
threats: Close-range melee when cornered.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Phalanx
spawn: Deserts, badlands and savannas.
mechanics: When the shield rises, frontal damage drops to 15%.
Flank or wait until the four-second stance ends.
threats: Its gun remains active between shield stances.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Psion
spawn: Deserts, badlands and savannas.
mechanics: The cast marks a 2.8-block zone before it erupts.
Step outside the marker to avoid the suspension field.
threats: The field persists briefly after the cast.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Centurion
spawn: Deserts, badlands and savannas.
mechanics: The Centurion crouches, then launches into a jet-assisted jump.
Keep cover between you and its aerial firing bursts.
threats: Watch its landing position before closing in.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Colossus
spawn: Deserts, badlands and savannas.
mechanics: A marked cast precedes three tracking missiles.
Break line of sight with solid cover while they approach.
threats: The Colossus also fires ordinary ranged bursts.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Warbeast
spawn: Deserts, badlands and savannas.
mechanics: A landing circle appears before the leap.
Move sideways out of the circle before the dive hits.
threats: The impact damages and knocks back nearby targets.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Incendior
spawn: Deserts, badlands and savannas.
mechanics: Keep more than seven blocks away from the flame stream.
Use cover or a long-range weapon.
threats: Close hits set the target on fire for two seconds.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Taken Thrall
spawn: Forests, dark forests and old-growth pine taiga.
mechanics: Watch the departure particles and the collapse of its silhouette.
Reacquire it after the teleport; the move uses nearby clear ground.
threats: Taken Thrall close to melee range quickly.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Taken Acolyte
spawn: Forests, dark forests and old-growth pine taiga.
mechanics: Avoid the marked Void cast and its follow-up bolts.
Use cover during the projectile volley.
threats: Acolytes can keep firing while other Taken support them.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Taken Goblin
spawn: Forests, dark forests and old-growth pine taiga.
mechanics: During its support stance it protects and heals nearby Taken within seven blocks.
Defeat the Goblin to cut those support pulses.
threats: Supported allies gain temporary damage resistance.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Taken Captain
spawn: Forests, dark forests and old-growth pine taiga.
mechanics: Its special attack launches a slow Darkness projectile.
Strafe away from the projectile and use solid cover.
threats: The Captain can pressure at range while allies advance.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Taken Knight
spawn: Forests, dark forests and old-growth pine taiga.
mechanics: The Knight marks a burning zone before casting.
Move outside the mark; do not stand in the lingering fire.
threats: The hazard lasts five seconds.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Taken Phalanx
spawn: Forests, dark forests and old-growth pine taiga.
mechanics: Flank its shield to avoid frontal damage reduction.
Back away more than six blocks during the raised-shield blast.
threats: Repulsion can push you toward other hazards.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Stalker
spawn: Swamps, mangrove swamps and dark forests.
mechanics: Fires a three-shot burst after raising its weapon.
Move between bursts; solid blocks stop the incoming bolts.
threats: Close-range melee when cornered.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Raider
spawn: Swamps, mangrove swamps and dark forests.
mechanics: The Raider compresses into mist, then reforms nearby.
Track the particle flash and prepare for its next shot.
threats: Its precision weapon punishes standing still.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Lurker
spawn: Swamps, mangrove swamps and dark forests.
mechanics: When the shield rises, frontal damage drops to 15%.
Flank or wait until the four-second stance ends.
threats: Its gun remains active between shield stances.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Ravager
spawn: Swamps, mangrove swamps and dark forests.
mechanics: Stay clear of the marked burning impact.
Backpedal when the Ravager reaches melee range.
threats: Censer hits leave a short-lived fire patch.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Chieftain
spawn: Swamps, mangrove swamps and dark forests.
mechanics: The Chieftain channels support to Scorn within seven blocks.
Focus it to remove healing and short-lived protection from its allies.
threats: Do not spend heavy ammunition on heavily supported targets.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Screeb
spawn: Swamps, mangrove swamps and dark forests.
mechanics: The Screeb commits to a short detonation windup at close range.
Kill it early or move beyond the four-block blast.
threats: Its explosion damages entities without destroying terrain.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Abomination
spawn: Swamps, mangrove swamps and dark forests.
mechanics: An Arc line and ground marker telegraph the blast.
Leave the three-block marked impact area.
threats: The Abomination can survive several ordinary shots.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Grim
spawn: End highlands/midlands and selected high mountains.
mechanics: The Grim flies and fires from above.
Keep outside seven blocks or break line of sight during its screech.
threats: The screech briefly slows and disorients nearby targets.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Husk
spawn: End highlands/midlands and selected high mountains.
mechanics: Avoid the two-hit blade swing.
Land the final killing hit in the middle of its chest to prevent a Geist.
threats: Other killing blows release a pursuing Geist.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Attendant
spawn: End highlands/midlands and selected high mountains.
mechanics: A marked cast launches a slowing Stasis bolt.
Dodge the shot before it reaches you.
threats: Being slowed makes nearby melee enemies more dangerous.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Weaver
spawn: End highlands/midlands and selected high mountains.
mechanics: Watch the Strand cast and break line of sight.
Avoid the projectile to prevent being pulled out of cover.
threats: The pull can drag you into a second enemy's attack.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Omen
spawn: End highlands/midlands and selected high mountains.
mechanics: Three freezing zones spread sideways from the marked target.
Step beyond the fan instead of moving into an adjacent lane.
threats: The zones remain active after the Omen finishes casting.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Harbinger
spawn: End highlands/midlands and selected high mountains.
mechanics: A small ground marker precedes a suspension field.
Leave the marked area before the cast completes.
threats: The Harbinger is a durable ranged threat.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Tormentor
spawn: End highlands/midlands and selected high mountains.
mechanics: Break both glowing shoulder nodes with aimed hits; each needs 18 raw damage.
Until both nodes break, incoming damage is reduced to 35%.
Both broken nodes cause a brief stagger.
threats: Leave the landing marker before its leap attack.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Geist
spawn: Released by a Husk killed without a final chest hit.
mechanics: A Geist pursues after a Husk dies without a final chest hit.
Shoot its bright body before it reaches you.
threats: It bursts at close range.
reward: Faction material drops.

name: Valus Ta’aurc
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: A cast telegraphs a five-rocket tracking salvo.
Reach solid cover before the rockets arrive.
Use the pauses between salvos to deal damage; there is no immunity puzzle.
threats: Avoid clustering beside another Guardian.
Rocket impacts damage entities while leaving terrain intact.
reward: Two Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Taniks, the Scarred
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: His special move collapses his silhouette before a nearby blink.
Watch the departure flash and turn toward his new position.
A three-projectile artillery burst follows the teleport.
threats: Keep solid cover nearby; do not chase the departure position.
reward: Two Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Bracus Zahn
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: A cast summons two Legionaries and grants five seconds of shielding.
During that shield he takes only 20% incoming damage.
Clear the adds, escape the marked Solar hazard, then resume focused damage.
threats: Standing in the Solar pool deals repeated damage.
reward: Two Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Alak-Hul, the Darkblade
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: A five-block landing mark appears before the axe slam.
Move out before the axe falls, about 1.6 seconds into the move.
He repositions after the impact; reacquire him before attacking.
threats: Keep space for lateral movement and avoid walls behind you.
reward: Two Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Hashladûn
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: She floats while firing and periodically marks a four-block zone.
Move away before the cast lands; the burning cloud remains for five seconds.
Attack from a clear angle while keeping the cloud between fights out of your path.
threats: The cloud also applies Darkness.
reward: Two Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Fikrul, the Fanatic
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: His cast calls two Scorn Stalkers and pulls his target inward.
Immediately leave the Arc pool at the marked position.
Clear the adds between focused damage bursts.
threats: The Arc pool remains for roughly 4.5 seconds.
reward: Two Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Crota, Son of Oryx
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: Outside a kneel, Crota takes 40% incoming damage.
Bait his marked slam and leave its five-block impact circle.
After the slam, he kneels for four seconds: use that damage window.
A floating Oversoul appears. Destroy it before the end of the kneel to prevent its blast.
threats: An intact Oversoul bursts at 3.5 seconds into the kneel.
Maintain a route out of the 15-block blast radius.
reward: Four Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: The Templar
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: A special cast creates three floating shield nodes.
While the timed shield is active, incoming damage is reduced to 20%.
Destroy all three nodes to collapse protection early, then focus the central eye.
The Templar can rebuild the nodes on a later cast.
threats: The shield also expires after 7.5 seconds.
Keep cover from its ranged volleys while shooting nodes.
reward: Four Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Golgoroth
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: Strike from behind to draw its gaze.
Rear hits deal 1.5x damage and trigger a 2.75-second stagger.
Use the stagger for team damage while another Guardian controls its attention.
Move out of the marked slam and its lingering dark pool.
threats: Do not stand in the four-block pool after the slam.
reward: Four Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Rhulk, Disciple of the Witness
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: A straight line marks his rush for about 1.2 seconds.
Move sideways off that line before he accelerates.
After the rush he creates three resonant hazard lanes.
Move between or outside those lanes, then attack during recovery.
threats: The rush deals repeated close-range hits.
There is no symbol-deposit phase in this adaptation.
reward: Four Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Nezarec, Final God of Pain
spawn: Craft its named challenge sigil, then use it on clear ground. Nearby Guardians scale boss health.
mechanics: Aim at both glowing shoulder nodes; each requires 18 raw damage.
Until both break, he takes only 35% incoming damage.
Breaking both creates a brief stagger for focused fire.
Leave his leap marker, then stay clear of the five-block lingering dark zone.
threats: Do not follow him directly into his landing point.
reward: Four Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram.

name: Vorgeth, the Boundless Hunger
origin: Court of Petitions / The Shattered Throne
spawn: Use the Locator to find Court of Petitions. Right-click its entrance altar to begin. No sigil is needed.
mechanics: Activate the altar. Vorgeth is immune until the petition cycle is complete.
Defeat all four named Keepers of Petitions. Each kill adds a shared mark and refreshes a 45-second timer.
At four marks, stand for one second in the violet basin seven blocks toward the entrance from the center.
The shield falls for 20 seconds. Focus the eye while dodging Void bolts.
When the shield returns, repeat. An expired mark damages nearby Guardians and resets the Keepers.
threats: Use pillars to interrupt eye-blast volleys.
Move out of the three-block stomp marker.
reward: Three Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram. The altar recharges for five minutes. After ten seconds without a living survival Guardian nearby, the fight resets.

name: Zulmak, Instrument of Torment
origin: Cradle of Embers / Pit of Heresy
spawn: Use the Locator to find Cradle of Embers. Right-click its entrance altar to begin. No sigil is needed.
mechanics: Activate the altar, then defeat the three named Heretical Keepers around the arena.
After each kill, step into that Keeper's glowing outer seal. The team must extinguish all three seals.
Zulmak becomes vulnerable for 18 seconds. Damage counts only while the attacking Guardian is inside the ritual ring, within eight blocks of the center.
Clear the Cursed Thrall that enter during damage.
With three seconds remaining, leave the ring. His final flame blast hits the ring, then the Keepers return.
threats: Move outside the marked axe slam.
Leaving the damage ring early is safer than chasing one more shot.
reward: Three Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram. The altar recharges for five minutes. After ten seconds without a living survival Guardian nearby, the fight resets.

name: Phry'zhia, the Insatiable
spawn: Use the Locator to find Rusted Vault. Right-click its entrance altar to begin. No sigil is needed.
mechanics: Activate the altar. Break the two glowing side receivers with any weapon; each releases three Avarice hoarders.
Each hoarder drops two floating cursed engrams. Walk into them to collect Burdened by Riches.
Carry the engrams to the amber crystal seven blocks toward the entrance. Stand within two blocks to deposit them, one every half second.
A shared total of 12 deposits removes the shield for 20 seconds. Shoot the exposed eye, then repeat.
Carried riches expire after 30 seconds without another pickup, causing damage and losing those riches. Receivers return if more are needed.
threats: Keep pillars between you and the Ogre's shots.
Do not collect more riches than you can deliver before the timer expires.
reward: Three Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram. The altar recharges for five minutes. After ten seconds without a living survival Guardian nearby, the fight resets.

name: Akelous, the Siren's Current
origin: Siren's Watch / Spire of the Watcher
spawn: Use the Locator to find Siren's Watch. Right-click its entrance altar to begin. No sigil is needed.
mechanics: Activate the altar. Defeat the Conduit Minotaur to grant nearby Guardians 30 seconds of Arctrician.
While Arctrician is active, shoot terminal 1 then terminal 2 on each of the four radial circuits. Wrong-order shots do not advance a circuit.
Completing all four circuits exposes six eyes. Destroy all six within 15 seconds.
The central core is vulnerable for 15 seconds. Follow its slow retreat while keeping an escape route.
The final three seconds warn of Repulsion. Retreat beyond 13 blocks or behind solid cover. Survive the blast and repeat.
threats: A new Conduit Minotaur appears if the team needs another Arctrician buff.
Failing the eye timer triggers Repulsion and resets the circuits.
reward: Three Conquest Tokens, eight faction materials and an Exotic Engram. The altar recharges for five minutes. After ten seconds without a living survival Guardian nearby, the fight resets.
